Congress leader Kharge calls elections illegal and urges dissolution of Lok Sabha

Kharge said the Prime Minister and Home Minister are illegal, declared all elections illegal and demanded that the Lok Sabha and state assemblies be dissolved, while Shivraj Singh Chauhan criticised the remark as an insult to the people's mandate.
